site.name: SimLab
site.description: Un labo d’électronique pratique dans le navigateur : assemblez, câblez, programmez, cassez et faites voler cartes, robots et drones.

usage.label: Anonymous usage counts
usage.body: SimLab counts what happens in the labs (a lesson passed, a step built, a fault tried) for the live counters and leaderboards. Each event carries a random id for this browser, never your name or your code.
